structured_output.notes: Built strictly using Python 3 standard library (http.server, sqlite3, json, threading, urllib). All operations are thread-safe and isolated per-connection. Ephemeral port binding, daemon server thread lifecycle, clean shutdown, and security constraints on path traversal are implemented according to the specification.
structured_output.summary: Implemented MiniBoard backend in app/server.py and app/database.py with SQLite storage, full REST API endpoints, static file serving, and programmatic create_server factory.
